title: Bold markup has no effect on a monospace code span
body:
`markup::runs` in `crates/acre/src/scene/markup.rs` picks a run's font from two flags. A code span takes `Font::Mono` whether or not it sits inside `**...**`, because acre embeds only JetBrains Mono NL Regular. So `**`UnmaskedKeys`**` draws in regular mono, and the name looks no different from the code names in the text around it.

`figures/key-schemes.acre` shows it in three places. The headings of the `UnmaskedKeys`, `MaskedKeys` and `Packing` boxes in section 1 are bold mono. So are the column headings of the table in section 5, and the `bmi2` in the heading "pext and `bmi2`".

## Proposal

- Embed JetBrains Mono NL Bold beside the regular face. It is OFL, like the regular face, and its license is the `OFL.txt` already in `crates/acre/assets/fonts/`.
- Add `Font::MonoBold`, and map a code span inside bold markup to it.
- `font` accepts `mono-bold`.
